tokens.name: material-regular
tokens.usage: Glass for the tab bar, the minimised workout bar, pull-down menus. Only on controls and overlays.

tokens.name: material-thick
tokens.usage: Thicker glass for the dock, the rest card, sheets, the scrolled title bar and alerts.

tokens.name: material-edge
tokens.usage: The glass edge hairline.

tokens.name: accent-failure
tokens.usage: Coral: a failure set's number and the words TO FAILURE (only the word is coloured).

tokens.name: accent-drop
tokens.usage: Violet: the drop set's D badge, DROP SET, its logged dot.

tokens.name: accent-superset
tokens.usage: Blue: the A/B letter tags, a superset's edge line and the word Superset.

tokens.name: state-next-row
tokens.usage: The next set's row tint: primary at 12 %, laid over an opaque background so a swipe's red never shows through. Added in design 1 (built as primary.copy(alpha = .12f)).

tokens.name: map-route
tokens.usage: The run's route line on maps: primary, with a white or black casing from the map image.

styles.name: display-large
styles.usage: Apple text style under Material 3's name.

styles.name: display-medium
styles.usage: Apple text style under Material 3's name.

styles.name: display-small
styles.usage: Big numbers: the rest countdown, stat values.

styles.name: headline-large
styles.usage: Large screen titles: Home, Plan, You, Push A.

styles.name: headline-small
styles.usage: Template card names, the summary date, an empty workout's question.

styles.name: title-large
styles.usage: Keypad digits, dock fields, card titles.

styles.name: title-medium
styles.usage: Exercise names, row titles, bar titles, button labels in cards.

styles.name: title-small
styles.usage: Small buttons, list section headings, tile keys.

styles.name: body-large
styles.usage: Row text, set cells, body copy.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: Secondary row text, Previous on rows, meta lines.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: The now-label (semibold, tracked), Previous on the card, notes in grey.

styles.name: label-medium
styles.usage: Column labels, captions, the minimised bar's subline.

styles.name: focus-value
styles.usage: The focus card's values, 82.5 kg × 8 reps; units beside them in body-medium on-surface-variant.

styles.name: focus-times
styles.usage: The × between the focus card's values, on-surface-variant.

styles.name: now-label
styles.usage: NOW · BENCH PRESS BB · SET 2 OF 3, uppercase, in primary; the kind word in its kind colour.

styles.name: workout-title
styles.usage: The workout's large title, Push A.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inside controls; between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between chips, keys and stacked rows.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between a card's parts; row padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: The screen gutter; card padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: The tab bar's side inset.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Badge size; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: The grabber's width.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Large gaps on onboarding pages.

tokens.name: shape-extra-small
tokens.usage: Tags, bar marks, the joined tiles' inner corners.

tokens.name: shape-small
tokens.usage: Set cells, the ✓ box, segmented tracks, badges (polish: 8 → 10).

tokens.name: shape-medium
tokens.usage: Fields, keys, buttons inside cards, the add-set button.

tokens.name: shape-large
tokens.usage: Cards, lists, menus, the strip, the rest card, wide buttons.

tokens.name: shape-large-increased
tokens.usage: The workout's cards: the focus card, the overview card and the empty workout's card (polish: built 22, 18 and 24).

tokens.name: shape-extra-large
tokens.usage: Sheets, the dock's top corners, alerts, template cards.

tokens.name: shape-full
tokens.usage: Capsules: the tab bar, small buttons, chips, ⋯ pills.

tokens.name: material-shadow
tokens.usage: Under glass only: the tab bar, dock, rest card, menus, sheets. Cards and lists have none.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Every tap target (listed deviations aside: RIR segments 29 × 44).

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Icons in bars and rows.

tokens.name: size-ring-small
tokens.usage: The rest card's amber ring.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Row separators, glass edges.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: A focused field's ring, the next set's ✓ outline, rest lines.

tokens.name: state-pressed-scale
tokens.usage: A pressed button shrinks to this scale (P2).

tokens.name: state-pressed-opacity
tokens.usage: …and dims to this opacity.

tokens.name: state-disabled-opacity
tokens.usage: Disabled controls, dropped days under Short week.

tokens.name: state-scrim-opacity
tokens.usage: The scrim behind alerts and action sheets.

tokens.name: state-veil-opacity
tokens.usage: The Start bubbles' nearly clear panel (on-surface at this opacity).
